killedBy: createStatsStore: the CAMPAIGN RUN scope adopts another tab's New Game rather than outranking it with a stale shadow
why: Leaves the run tally out of the resync, so this instance's shadow outranks disk forever -- PR #62's defect class, on the second persisted scope. A New Game or a Reset stats performed in another tab is undone by the next frame this tab records. Caught by the reload case because a second store instance reads disk at construction and then accumulates on top of a shadow the first instance's writes are still overwriting. Pinned by the cross-tab case rather than the reload one: a second store instance reads disk at construction either way, so only a tab that keeps RECORDING after another has reset can see a shadow outrank disk.
